en.flash: Mới: jungle, lake, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn: travel, visit, London, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, shark, whale, island, village, kangaroo, panda, zoo
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Good morning! Let's visit the zoo! 我们去参观动物园吧！· Chuyển ý: Now, it's speaking time. 现在说一说。· Khen: Good thinking! 想得真好！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: jungle, waterfall 1) Nghe và tô màu tranh vườn thú (dạng Movers Listening tô màu, 4 lệnh): Colour the parrot red. / Colour the penguin next to the lake black and white. / Colour the waterfall blue. / Colour the tree in the jungle green. 2) Ôn không tranh – trò chơi "Guess where!": cô đọc gợi ý, con nói nơi: I can see a whale and a rock. (an island) / I can see a tractor and a field. (the countryside) / I can see a parrot and tall trees. (the jungle). 3) Nói câu mục đích theo thẻ: I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas. / I want to go to the island to see the whales. 4) Movers Nói phần 3 – Chọn tranh khác loại và giải thích (mẫu; từng con với cô). Cô: Look at these four pictures. One is different. The parrot, the penguin and the whale are animals, but the tractor isn't an animal. Now you look at these pictures. Which one is different? Why? – Con: (a) shark / whale / penguin / snail → I think the snail is different because it doesn't live in the sea. (b) lake / waterfall / island / swimming pool → I think the swimming pool is different because people make it. (c) parrot / penguin / kangaroo / snail → I think the snail is different because it hasn't got legs. Cô hỏi thêm: What do we feed the penguins? – Fish.
en.truyen: At the Zoo — Xiaomei visits a big zoo in Beijing with her mum. "I want to see the pandas!" she says. First they see a red parrot from the jungle. "Hello!" says the parrot. Xiaomei laughs. Then they see penguins swim in a small lake. Next to the pandas there's a waterfall. The pandas are eating. "They're so cute!" says Xiaomei, and she takes lots of photos.
en.baihat: At the Zoo (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The parrot in the jungle says "Hello, hello!" / "Hello, hello! Hello, hello!" / The penguins in the lake go swim, swim, swim, / All day long! / The panda by the waterfall eats, eats, eats, / All day long!

zh.flash: Mới: 参观 cānguān, 企鹅 qǐ'é | Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 票 piào, 行李箱 xínglixiāng, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 上车 shàng chē, 下车 xià chē, 鲸鱼 jīngyú, 鲨鱼 shāyú, 小岛 xiǎodǎo, 村子 cūnzi, 袋鼠 dàishǔ, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 动物园 dòngwùyuán | Nghe làm quen: 湖 hú, 瀑布 pùbù, 鹦鹉 yīngwǔ, 丛林 cónglín
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và tô màu tranh vườn thú (4 lệnh, cùng tranh bài tiếng Anh): 红鹦鹉 → tô đỏ / 湖旁边的企鹅 → tô đen trắng / 瀑布 → tô xanh dương / 丛林里的树 → tô xanh lá. 2) Ôn không tranh – trò chơi "Đoán nơi": cô nói 我能看见鲸鱼和大石头 → con nói 小岛; 我能看见拖拉机和田 → 农村; 我能看见鹦鹉和很高的树 → 丛林. 3) Nói câu mục đích theo thẻ: 我想去动物园看熊猫。/ 我想去小岛看鲸鱼。 4) Chọn tranh khác loại rồi nói (cùng bộ tranh Movers Nói phần 3): 鲨鱼 / 鲸鱼 / 企鹅 / 蜗牛 → 我觉得蜗牛不一样，因为它不住在海里。/ 湖 / 瀑布 / 小岛 / 游泳池 → 我觉得游泳池不一样，因为它是人做的。Cô hỏi thêm: 我们喂企鹅吃什么？— 鱼。 [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh vườn thú: Leo nói "I want to go to the zoo to see the pandas.", Xiaomei nói "我想去动物园看熊猫。"; con tìm chỗ khác (tiếng Trung không cần to). Cặp Penguins can swim, but they can't fly ↔ 企鹅会游泳，可是不会飞 (can ↔ 会, but ↔ 可是). [Chuyển ngữ] [Larva: 2–3 câu] Xiaomei nhắn bằng tiếng Trung: "我在北京参观动物园。企鹅在水里游泳。熊猫很可爱！" Con nói lại bằng tiếng Anh cho Anna: I'm visiting the zoo in Beijing. The penguins swim in the water. The pandas are so cute! [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "Yesterday Anna and her grandpa went to the zoo to see the pandas. Near the lake, the penguins were swimming in the cold water, and Anna fed them some fish. After that, they walked through the jungle. There they saw a beautiful waterfall and some noisy red parrots." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: Anna和爷爷去动物园看熊猫。Anna喂企鹅吃鱼。他们还看见了瀑布和红鹦鹉。 (Anna hé yéye qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo. Anna wèi qǐ'é chī yú. Tāmen hái kànjiàn le pùbù hé hóng yīngwǔ.)
zh.truyen: 参观动物园 — Xiaomei和妈妈去北京参观一个大动物园。Xiaomei说：“我想看熊猫！”她们先看见一只从丛林来的红鹦鹉，它说：“你好！”Xiaomei笑了。然后她们看见企鹅在一个小湖里游泳。熊猫旁边有一个瀑布。熊猫在吃东西。Xiaomei说：“它们真可爱！”她拍了很多照片。(Xiaomei hé māma qù Běijīng cānguān yí gè dà dòngwùyuán. Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng kàn xióngmāo!” Tāmen xiān kànjiàn yì zhī cóng cónglín lái de hóng yīngwǔ, tā shuō: “Nǐ hǎo!” Xiaomei xiào le. Ránhòu tāmen kànjiàn qǐ'é zài yí gè xiǎo hú li yóuyǒng. Xióngmāo pángbiān yǒu yí gè pùbù. Xióngmāo zài chī dōngxi. Xiaomei shuō: “Tāmen zhēn kě'ài!” Tā pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn.)
zh.baihat: 在动物园 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 丛林里的鹦鹉说“你好，你好！”/ “你好，你好！你好，你好！”/ 湖里的企鹅游，游，游，/ 游一整天！/ 瀑布旁的熊猫吃，吃，吃，/ 吃一整天！(Cónglín li de yīngwǔ shuō “nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo!” / “Nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ hǎo, nǐ hǎo!” / Hú li de qǐ'é yóu, yóu, yóu, / yóu yì zhěng tiān! / Pùbù páng de xióngmāo chī, chī, chī, / chī yì zhěng tiān!)

en.truyen: Anna's Dream Trip — Anna has a dream. She packs a heavy suitcase with her ice skates and her toothpaste and gets on a plane to London. She gets off and goes to a hotel with a big swimming pool. The next day she takes a ship to an island. She sees a whale and takes a photo. Then Mum says, "Wake up, Anna!" zh.truyen: Anna的梦 — Anna做了一个梦。她的行李箱很重，里面有滑冰鞋和牙膏。她坐飞机去伦敦。下飞机以后，她去一个有大游泳池的酒店。第二天，她坐船去一个小岛，看见一条鲸鱼，还拍了照片。妈妈说：“Anna，起床了！”这只是一个梦，可是Anna很想有一天去伦敦！(Anna zuò le yí gè mèng. zh.tu: Ôn: 想去 xiǎng qù, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 车站 chēzhàn, 上车 shàng chē, 下车 xià chē, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 北京 Běijīng, 飞机 fēijī, 动物园 dòngwùyuán, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 拍照 pāizhào, 海滩 hǎitān | Ôn nhanh: 找 zhǎo, 汉语 Hànyǔ
zh.cum: 你想去哪儿 nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr / 我要去…… wǒ yào qù… / 你怎么去…… nǐ zěnme qù… / 坐飞机 zuò fēijī / 看熊猫 kàn xióngmāo / 在海滩上拍照 zài hǎitān shang pāizhào
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] How do you get to Beijing? ↔ 你怎么去北京？[khác: How đứng đầu câu, 怎么 đứng sau 你, trước 去] / [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Anh, nói câu tiếng Trung] 你想去哪儿？(Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?) / 我要去伦敦。(Wǒ yào qù Lúndūn.) / 你怎么去北京？(Nǐ zěnme qù Běijīng?) / 我坐飞机去北京。(Wǒ zuò fēijī qù Běijīng.) / 我想去动物园看熊猫。(Wǒ xiǎng qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.) / 我想在海滩上拍照。(Wǒ xiǎng zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 – làm quen, 5 câu dài; trên web: nghe 1 lần rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói, ~10 phút] 我想跟爸爸妈妈一起去伦敦旅行。(Wǒ xiǎng gēn bàba māma yìqǐ qù Lúndūn lǚxíng.) / 我们坐飞机去北京，然后去动物园看熊猫。(Wǒmen zuò fēijī qù Běijīng, ránhòu qù dòngwùyuán kàn xióngmāo.) / 假期的时候，我喜欢在海滩上拍照。(Jiàqī de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan zài hǎitān shang pāizhào.) / Leo的奶奶只会说汉语，所以Leo帮助她。(Leo de nǎinai zhǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ, suǒyǐ Leo bāngzhù tā.) / 我们参观了很多地方，大家都很开心。(Wǒmen cānguān le hěn duō dìfang, dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译Leo — Leo和家人在伦敦的一个酒店。奶奶只会说汉语，她想去参观动物园。Leo用英语问酒店的叔叔：“我们怎么去动物园？”“在车站上公共汽车，在动物园下车。”Leo用汉语告诉奶奶。奶奶说：“谢谢你，Leo！”(Leo hé jiārén zài Lúndūn de yí gè jiǔdiàn. Nǎinai zhǐ huì shuō Hànyǔ, tā xiǎng qù cānguān dòngwùyuán. Leo yòng Yīngyǔ wèn jiǔdiàn de shūshu: “Wǒmen zěnme qù dòngwùyuán?” “Zài chēzhàn shàng gōnggòng qìchē, zài dòngwùyuán xià chē.” Leo yòng Hànyǔ gàosu nǎinai. Nǎinai shuō: “Xièxie nǐ, Leo!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你怎么去 坐公共汽车 儿歌"

en.flash: Ôn: travel, visit, London, world, map, ticket, suitcase, hotel, get on, get off, shark, whale, island, swimming pool, countryside, village, jungle, waterfall, parrot, penguin | Ôn từ khóa trước: plane, ship, trip, near, far
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Close your eyes. Let's dream! 闭上眼睛。· Chuyển ý: Next, let's be little interpreters. 下面我们做小翻译。· Khen: Amazing! 真棒！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: dream / 梦 1) Đọc truyện, chọn từ đúng điền vào chỗ trống (dạng Movers Reading, 5 chỗ, từ: suitcase / plane / hotel / island / whale): Anna packs a heavy ___. / She gets on a ___ to London. / Her ___ has got a swimming pool. / She takes a ship to an ___. / She sees a ___. 2) Dự án mini "My Dream Trip": con vẽ chuyến đi mơ ước và nói 3 câu: I want to visit … / I'm going to go by … / I want to … there. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: bạn A nói câu tiếng Trung, bạn B nói tiếng Anh: Where do you want to go? / I go to Beijing by plane. / I want to take photos on the beach. 4) Ôn nhanh "Which one is different?" (Movers Nói phần 3, cả lớp giơ tay nói): suitcase / ticket / map / snail → I think the snail is different because it's an animal.
en.truyen: Anna's Dream Trip — Anna has a dream. She packs a heavy suitcase and gets her ticket. She gets on a plane to London. When she gets off, she goes to a hotel with a big swimming pool. The next day she takes a ship to an island. She sees a whale and a shark, and she takes lots of photos. Then she flies to Beijing to visit the pandas. "Wake up, Anna!" says Mum. It's only a dream, but Anna wants to travel around the world one day!
en.baihat: My Dream Trip (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Pack my suitcase, here's my ticket, / Get on the plane, we fly away! / London, Beijing, see the world, / Sharks and whales and pandas play. / Pack my suitcase, here's my ticket, / My dream trip starts today!

zh.flash: Ôn: 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 伦敦 Lúndūn, 地图 dìtú, 票 piào, 行李箱 xínglixiāng, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 上 shàng (上飞机), 下 xià (下飞机), 鲨鱼 shāyú, 鲸鱼 jīngyú, 小岛 xiǎodǎo, 游泳池 yóuyǒngchí, 农村 nóngcūn, 村子 cūnzi, 丛林 cónglín, 鹦鹉 yīngwǔ, 瀑布 pùbù, 企鹅 qǐ'é | Ôn từ khóa trước: 飞机 fēijī, 船 chuán, 近 jìn, 远 yuǎn | Nghe làm quen: 世界 shìjiè (= world)
zh.slide: 1) Đọc truyện, chọn từ điền chỗ trống (5 chỗ, cùng truyện bài tiếng Anh; từ: 行李箱 / 飞机 / 酒店 / 小岛 / 鲸鱼): Anna的___很重。/ 她坐___去伦敦。/ 她的___有一个游泳池。/ 她坐船去一个___。/ 她看见一条___。 2) Dự án mini "我梦想的旅行": con nói 3 câu về tranh của mình: 我想去…… / 我坐……去…… / 我想在那儿…… 3) [Chuyển ngữ] Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói câu tiếng Trung: Where do you want to go? → 你想去哪儿？/ I go to Beijing by plane. → 我坐飞机去北京。/ I want to take photos on the beach. → 我想在海滩上拍照。 [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "One night Anna had a wonderful dream. She packed a heavy suitcase and got on a plane to London. Her hotel had a big swimming pool. The next day she took a ship to an island, and on the beach she suddenly saw a whale!" → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: Anna做了一个梦。她坐飞机去伦敦，她的酒店有一个游泳池。然后她坐船去一个小岛，看见了一条鲸鱼！ (Anna zuò le yí gè mèng. Tā zuò fēijī qù Lúndūn, tā de jiǔdiàn yǒu yí gè yóuyǒngchí. Ránhòu tā zuò chuán qù yí gè xiǎodǎo, kànjiàn le yì tiáo jīngyú!) 4) Ôn nhanh "Cái nào khác loại?" (cả lớp giơ tay nói): 行李箱 / 票 / 地图 / 蜗牛 → 我觉得蜗牛不一样，因为它是动物。 [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh truyện Anna's Dream Trip: Leo nói "Anna has a dream.", Xiaomei nói "Anna做了一个梦。"; con nhận ra have a dream ↔ 做梦 (động từ khác). Cặp I'm going to go to London ↔ 我要去伦敦.
zh.truyen: Anna的梦 — Anna做了一个梦。她的行李箱很重，她拿着票上飞机去伦敦。下飞机以后，她去一个有大游泳池的酒店。第二天，她坐船去一个小岛，看见一条鲸鱼和一条鲨鱼，拍了很多照片。然后她坐飞机去北京看熊猫。妈妈说：“Anna，起床了！”这只是一个梦，可是Anna想有一天环游世界！(Anna zuò le yí gè mèng. Tā de xínglixiāng hěn zhòng, tā ná zhe piào shàng fēijī qù Lúndūn. Xià fēijī yǐhòu, tā qù yí gè yǒu dà yóuyǒngchí de jiǔdiàn. Dì-èr tiān, tā zuò chuán qù yí gè xiǎodǎo, kànjiàn yì tiáo jīngyú hé yì tiáo shāyú, pāi le hěn duō zhàopiàn. Ránhòu tā zuò fēijī qù Běijīng kàn xióngmāo. Māma shuō: “Anna, qǐchuáng le!” Zhè zhǐ shì yí gè mèng, kěshì Anna xiǎng yǒu yì tiān huányóu shìjiè!)
zh.baihat: 我梦想的旅行 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 拿好行李箱，拿好票，/ 上了飞机飞呀飞！/ 伦敦、北京，去看看，/ 鲨鱼、鲸鱼、大熊猫。/ 拿好行李箱，拿好票，/ 今天我们去旅行！(Ná hǎo xínglixiāng, ná hǎo piào, / shàng le fēijī fēi ya fēi! / Lúndūn, Běijīng, qù kànkan, / shāyú, jīngyú, dà xióngmāo. / Ná hǎo xínglixiāng, ná hǎo piào, / jīntiān wǒmen qù lǚxíng!)

en.tu: Mới: festival, holiday, celebrate | Ôn: birthday, candle, card, present, ice skating, team
en.cum: my favourite festival / on holiday / celebrate New Year / celebrate my birthday / with my family
en.cau: What's your favourite festival? – My favourite festival is New Year. / We celebrate New Year with our family. / I'm very happy at New Year. / We are on holiday at New Year. / We celebrate my birthday with a cake and candles. / There's a circus at the festival in the city centre. / I want to invite my friends to my birthday party.
en.truyen: Our Favourite Festivals — The teacher asks, "What's your favourite festival?" Leo says, "I like my birthday best! We celebrate it with a cake and candles." Anna says, "My favourite festival is New Year. We are on holiday and we celebrate with our family. I'm very happy at New Year!"

zh.tu: Mới: 节日 jiérì (= festival), 庆祝 qìngzhù (= celebrate) | Ôn: 生日 shēngrì, 高兴 gāoxìng, 新年 xīnnián, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 蜡烛 làzhú, 请 qǐng, 市中心 shì zhōngxīn | Ôn nhanh: 礼物 lǐwù, 卡片 kǎpiàn | Nghe làm quen: 放假 fàngjià (= on holiday), 马戏 mǎxì (= circus)
zh.cum: 我最喜欢的节日 wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiérì / 庆祝新年 qìngzhù xīnnián / 庆祝生日 qìngzhù shēngrì / 和家人一起 hé jiārén yìqǐ / 新年放假 xīnnián fàngjià / 吃蛋糕 chī dàngāo / 请朋友来 qǐng péngyou lái
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] What's your favourite festival? ↔ 你最喜欢什么节日？[khác: favourite ↔ 最喜欢; What đứng đầu, 什么节日 đứng cuối] / 你最喜欢什么节日？——我最喜欢新年。(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì? — Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xīnnián.) / 新年我们和家人一起庆祝。(Xīnnián wǒmen hé jiārén yìqǐ qìngzhù.) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.) / 新年我们放假。(Xīnnián wǒmen fàngjià.) / 我们吃蛋糕，点蜡烛，庆祝我的生日。(Wǒmen chī dàngāo, diǎn làzhú, qìngzhù wǒ de shēngrì.) / 市中心的节日有马戏。(Shì zhōngxīn de jiérì yǒu mǎxì.) / 我想请朋友们来我的生日会。(Wǒ xiǎng qǐng péngyoumen lái wǒ de shēngrì huì.)
zh.truyen: 我最喜欢的节日 — 老师问：“你最喜欢什么节日？”Leo说：“我最喜欢我的生日！我们吃蛋糕，点蜡烛。”Anna说：“我最喜欢新年。新年我们放假，和家人一起庆祝。新年我很开心！”(Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan wǒ de shēngrì! Wǒmen chī dàngāo, diǎn làzhú.” Anna shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xīnnián. Xīnnián wǒmen fàngjià, hé jiārén yìqǐ qìngzhù. Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn!”)

en.tu: Mới: mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern | Ôn: moon, star, autumn, sweet, practise, volleyball
en.cum: the Mid-Autumn Festival / eat mooncakes / a red lantern / a star lantern / look at the moon
en.cau: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. / I've got a red star lantern. / Mooncakes are very sweet. / The moon is big and round tonight.
en.truyen: The Mid-Autumn Festival — It's the Mid-Autumn Festival. Xiaomei and Bông have got lanterns. Xiaomei's lantern is a red star and Bông's lantern is a fish. They eat sweet mooncakes with Grandma and look at the big, round moon. "This is my favourite festival!" says Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Mid-Autumn Festival for kids explained"

zh.tu: Mới: 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié (= Mid-Autumn Festival), 月饼 yuèbǐng (= mooncake), 灯笼 dēnglong (= lantern) | Ôn: 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 秋天 qiūtiān, 甜 tián | Ôn nhanh: 排球 páiqiú
zh.cum: 过中秋节 guò Zhōngqiū Jié / 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 红灯笼 hóng dēnglong / 星星灯笼 xīngxing dēnglong / 看月亮 kàn yuèliang
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] mooncake ↔ 月饼 [giống: ghép moon + cake ↔ 月 + 饼] · We eat mooncakes. ↔ 我们吃月饼。[khác: mooncakes thêm -s, 月饼 không đổi] / 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 中秋节我们吃月饼，看月亮。(Zhōngqiū Jié wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang.) / 我有一个红灯笼。(Wǒ yǒu yí gè hóng dēnglong.) / 月饼很甜。(Yuèbǐng hěn tián.) / [Chuyển ngữ] [Bông kể bằng tiếng Anh; con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho bà của Xiaomei] This is my favourite festival. We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. I've got a red lantern. → 这是我最喜欢的节日。我们吃月饼，看月亮。我有一个红灯笼。
zh.truyen: 中秋节 — 今天是中秋节。Xiaomei和Bông有灯笼。Xiaomei的灯笼是一个红星星，Bông的灯笼是一条鱼。她们和奶奶一起吃月饼，看月亮。月饼很甜，月亮很大！Bông说：“我最喜欢中秋节！”(Jīntiān shì Zhōngqiū Jié. Xiaomei hé Bông yǒu dēnglong. Xiaomei de dēnglong shì yí gè hóng xīngxing, Bông de dēnglong shì yì tiáo yú. Tāmen hé nǎinai yìqǐ chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang. Yuèbǐng hěn tián, yuèliang hěn dà! Bông shuō: “Wǒ zuì xǐhuan Zhōngqiū Jié!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中秋节 儿歌 月饼 灯笼"

en.flash: Mới: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern | Ôn: birthday, candle, present, moon, star, sweet, New Year, cake, circus
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Good morning! What's your favourite festival? 你最喜欢什么节日？· Chuyển ý: Now, colour the lanterns. 现在给灯笼涂颜色。· Khen: Beautiful! 真漂亮！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: festival, celebrate 1) Nhìn tranh, chọn từ đúng (6 tranh): festival / lantern / mooncake / moon / candle / present. 2) Nghe và tô màu chiếc đèn lồng (dạng Movers Listening tô màu, 4 lệnh): Colour the star lantern red. / Colour the fish lantern yellow. / Colour the mooncake brown. / Colour the moon in the sky orange. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp, ghi vào bảng của lớp: A: What's your favourite festival? B: My favourite festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. 4) Đọc thiệp mời, chọn Yes/No (dạng Movers Reading, 4 câu). "Dear Leo, I want to invite you to my birthday party on Sunday. We're going to go to the circus in the city centre! Love, Anna." – Anna invites Leo to her party. (yes) / The party is on Saturday. (no) / They are going to go to the circus. (yes) / The circus is in the village. (no)
en.truyen: The Mid-Autumn Festival — Today the teacher asks, "What's your favourite festival?" Leo says, "My birthday!" Bông says, "The Mid-Autumn Festival!" That evening, Bông and Xiaomei celebrate with Grandma. Xiaomei's lantern is a red star and Bông's lantern is a fish. They eat sweet mooncakes and look at the big, round moon. "This is the best festival!" says Bông. "We're on holiday tomorrow, too!"
en.baihat: Mid-Autumn Night (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Look at my lantern, red and round, / Look at the moon, big and round! / Eat a mooncake, sweet and nice, / Celebrate with friends tonight! / Look at my lantern, red and round, / Happy Mid-Autumn all around!

zh.flash: Mới: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong | Ôn: 生日 shēngrì, 新年 xīnnián, 月亮 yuèliang, 星星 xīngxing, 甜 tián, 礼物 lǐwù, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 蜡烛 làzhú | Nghe làm quen: 放假 fàngjià, 马戏 mǎxì
zh.slide: 1) Nghe từ, chọn tranh đúng (6 tranh, cùng tranh bài tiếng Anh): 节日 / 灯笼 / 月饼 / 月亮 / 蜡烛 / 礼物. 2) Nghe và tô màu đèn lồng (4 lệnh): 星星灯笼是红色的。/ 鱼灯笼是黄色的。/ 月饼是咖啡色的。/ 天上的月亮是橙色的。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你最喜欢什么节日？— 我最喜欢中秋节，我们吃月饼，看月亮。 4) Đọc thiệp mời, nói 对 hoặc 不对 (4 câu; cùng thiệp bài tiếng Anh): “Leo，星期天来我的生日会吧！我们去市中心看马戏！Anna” — Anna请Leo来生日会。(对) / 生日会在星期六。(不对) / 他们去看马戏。(对) / 马戏在村子里。(不对) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh đèn lồng và bánh trung thu: Leo nói "We eat mooncakes.", Xiaomei nói "我们吃月饼。"; con tìm từ ghép giống nhau (moon + cake ↔ 月 + 饼) và chỗ khác (mooncakes thêm -s ↔ 月饼 không đổi). [Chuyển ngữ] [Larva: 2–3 câu] Bông kể bằng tiếng Anh: "My favourite festival is the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. I've got a fish lantern." Con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho bà của Xiaomei: 我最喜欢中秋节。我们吃月饼，看月亮。我有一个鱼灯笼。 [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "The Mid-Autumn Festival is Bông's favourite festival. Every year, her family eats mooncakes together and looks at the bright full moon. Bông usually carries a fish lantern, and her brother has got a star lantern. They put candles inside the lanterns." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: Bông最喜欢中秋节。她家一起吃月饼，看月亮。Bông有一个鱼灯笼，她哥哥有一个星星灯笼。 (Bông zuì xǐhuan Zhōngqiū Jié. Tā jiā yìqǐ chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang. Bông yǒu yí gè yú dēnglong, tā gēge yǒu yí gè xīngxing dēnglong.)
zh.truyen: 中秋节 — 老师问：“你最喜欢什么节日？”Leo说：“我的生日！”Bông说：“中秋节！”晚上，Bông、Xiaomei和奶奶一起庆祝中秋节。Xiaomei的灯笼是一个红星星，Bông的灯笼是一条鱼。她们吃月饼，看月亮。月饼很甜，月亮又大又圆！Bông说：“这是最好的节日！明天我们也放假！”(Lǎoshī wèn: “Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ de shēngrì!” Bông shuō: “Zhōngqiū Jié!” Wǎnshang, Bông, Xiaomei hé nǎinai yìqǐ qìngzhù Zhōngqiū Jié. Xiaomei de dēnglong shì yí gè hóng xīngxing, Bông de dēnglong shì yì tiáo yú. Tāmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang. Yuèbǐng hěn tián, yuèliang yòu dà yòu yuán! Bông shuō: “Zhè shì zuì hǎo de jiérì! Míngtiān wǒmen yě fàngjià!”)
zh.baihat: 中秋之夜 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 看我灯笼，红又圆，/ 看看月亮，大又圆！/ 吃个月饼，甜又甜，/ 今晚和朋友庆祝！/ 看我灯笼，红又圆，/ 祝大家中秋快乐！(Kàn wǒ dēnglong, hóng yòu yuán, / kànkan yuèliang, dà yòu yuán! / Chī gè yuèbǐng, tián yòu tián, / jīnwǎn hé péngyou qìngzhù! / Kàn wǒ dēnglong, hóng yòu yuán, / zhù dàjiā Zhōngqiū kuàilè!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 52. Unit 12 · Let's Celebrate – Tết: lì xì, lời chúc, múa lân, pháo hoa

web.label: Ngày 103. Unit 12 · Tết: tiền lì xì và lời chúc

en.tu: Mới: lucky, wish, gift | Ôn từ nối: travel, visit, village, take photos | Ôn nhanh: win, match
en.cum: lucky money / my lucky number / I wish you … / a New Year gift / visit Grandma and Grandpa
en.cau: What do you do at New Year? – We get lucky money. / We visit our grandparents at New Year. / I wish you a happy New Year! / Grandpa gives me a gift. / Seven is my lucky number. / At New Year we go to the circus with our cousins.
en.truyen: Lucky Money — At New Year, Nhan and his family travel to his grandparents' village. Nhan says, "I wish you a happy New Year, Grandma!" Grandma gives him some lucky money and a small gift. "Thank you! I'm very lucky!" says Nhan. Then everyone takes photos together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Lunar New Year lucky money for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 红包 hóngbāo (= lucky money) | Ôn từ nối: 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 村子 cūnzi, 拍照 pāizhào | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 数字 shùzì, 马戏 mǎxì | Ôn nhanh: 比赛 bǐsài, 赢 yíng | Nghe làm quen: 幸运 xìngyùn (= lucky), 祝 zhù (= wish), 表哥 biǎogē / 表姐 biǎojiě (= cousin)
zh.cum: 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 一个大红包 yí gè dà hóngbāo / 祝你新年快乐 zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè / 一个小礼物 yí gè xiǎo lǐwù / 我的幸运数字 wǒ de xìngyùn shùzì / 去爷爷奶奶的村子 qù yéye nǎinai de cūnzi
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] lucky money ↔ 红包 [khác: tiếng Trung gọi theo phong bao màu đỏ, không dịch từng chữ] · I wish you a happy New Year! ↔ 祝你新年快乐！[giống: I wish you ↔ 祝你 đứng đầu câu] / 新年你们做什么？——我们拿红包。(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme? — Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 新年我们去看爷爷奶奶。(Xīnnián wǒmen qù kàn yéye nǎinai.) / 奶奶，祝你新年快乐！(Nǎinai, zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!) / 爷爷给我一个礼物。(Yéye gěi wǒ yí gè lǐwù.) / 七是我的幸运数字。(Qī shì wǒ de xìngyùn shùzì.) / 新年我们和表哥表姐一起去看马戏。(Xīnnián wǒmen hé biǎogē biǎojiě yìqǐ qù kàn mǎxì.)
zh.truyen: 拿红包 — 新年，Nhan和家人去爷爷奶奶的村子。Nhan说：“奶奶，祝你新年快乐！”奶奶给他一个红包和一个小礼物。Nhan说：“谢谢奶奶！我真幸运！”然后，大家一起拍照。(Xīnnián, Nhan hé jiārén qù yéye nǎinai de cūnzi. Nhan shuō: “Nǎinai, zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!” Nǎinai gěi tā yí gè hóngbāo hé yí gè xiǎo lǐwù. Nhan shuō: “Xièxie nǎinai! Wǒ zhēn xìngyùn!” Ránhòu, dàjiā yìqǐ pāizhào.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "新年快乐 红包 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 104. Unit 12 · Múa lân, pháo hoa, nhảy dây ngày Tết

en.tu: Mới: firework, during, skip | Ôn từ nối: city centre, get on, get off, hotel | Ôn nhanh: ice skating, volleyball
en.cum: watch the fireworks / the lion dance / during New Year / during the festival / skip in the playground
en.cau: [Từ chức năng: during] During New Year, we watch the fireworks. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / During the holiday, children skip in the playground. / The fireworks are big and loud. / Can you skip? – Yes, I can!
en.truyen: Fireworks in the City — During New Year, Leo's family gets on a bus to the city centre. They get off and watch the lion dance. Then the fireworks start. They are big, loud and beautiful! Leo's sister skips and laughs. "Come on, Leo! Let's skip too!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "lion dance for kids New Year fireworks"

zh.tu: Mới: 舞狮 wǔshī (= lion dance), 烟花 yānhuā (= firework) | Ôn từ nối: 市中心 shì zhōngxīn, 上车 shàng chē, 下车 xià chē, 酒店 jiǔdiàn | Ôn: 狮子 shīzi, 跳 tiào, 时候 shíhou, 声音 shēngyīn | Ôn nhanh: 滑冰 huábīng, 排球 páiqiú | Nghe làm quen: 跳绳 tiàoshéng (= skip)
zh.cum: 看烟花 kàn yānhuā / 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 新年的时候 xīnnián de shíhou / 节日的时候 jiérì de shíhou / 在操场上跳绳 zài cāochǎng shang tiàoshéng
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] During New Year, we watch the fireworks. ↔ 新年的时候，我们看烟花。[giống: thời gian đứng đầu câu; khác: during đứng trước, 的时候 đứng sau] / [Ngữ pháp: ……的时候 – trong dịp] 新年的时候，我们看烟花。(Xīnnián de shíhou, wǒmen kàn yānhuā.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 放假的时候，小朋友们在操场上跳绳。(Fàngjià de shíhou, xiǎopéngyoumen zài cāochǎng shang tiàoshéng.) / 烟花很大，声音也很大。(Yānhuā hěn dà, shēngyīn yě hěn dà.) / 你会跳绳吗？——会！(Nǐ huì tiàoshéng ma? — Huì!) / [Chuyển ngữ] [Nhan kể bằng tiếng Anh; con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho bà] Grandma gives me lucky money. During New Year, we watch the lion dance and the fireworks. → 奶奶给我红包。新年的时候，我们看舞狮，看烟花。
zh.truyen: 市中心的烟花 — 新年的时候，Leo和家人上公共汽车去市中心。他们下车，看舞狮。然后有烟花，烟花很大，声音很大，真漂亮！Leo的妹妹又跳绳又笑：“快来，Leo！我们一起跳绳吧！”(Xīnnián de shíhou, Leo hé jiārén shàng gōnggòng qìchē qù shì zhōngxīn. Tāmen xià chē, kàn wǔshī. Ránhòu yǒu yānhuā, yānhuā hěn dà, shēngyīn hěn dà, zhēn piàoliang! Leo de mèimei yòu tiàoshéng yòu xiào: “Kuài lái, Leo! Wǒmen yìqǐ tiàoshéng ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "舞狮 烟花 新年 儿童"

en.flash: Mới: lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip | Ôn: travel, visit, village, city centre, take photos, lion, dance
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Happy New Year, everyone! 新年快乐！· Chuyển ý: Now, listen and match. 现在听一听，连一连。· Khen: Well done! 很好！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: lucky, during / ……的时候 1) Nghe và nối người với hoạt động ngày Tết (dạng Movers Listening Part 1, 5 người): Nhan gets lucky money. / Grandma gives a gift. / Leo watches the fireworks. / Leo's sister skips. / Grandpa takes photos. 2) Đọc và chọn từ đúng (thẻ nhiễu: brave, boring, exciting): During New Year, we watch the ___. (fireworks) / I ___ you a happy New Year! (wish) / Seven is my ___ number. (lucky) 3) Viết thiệp chúc Tết trên slide rồi đọc to: Dear Grandma, I wish you a happy New Year! Love, …
en.truyen: New Year with Grandma — At New Year, Nhan and his family travel to his grandparents' village. Nhan says, "I wish you a happy New Year, Grandma!" Grandma gives him lucky money and a small gift. "I'm very lucky!" says Nhan. During the holiday, they visit the city centre. They watch the lion dance and the fireworks. Nhan's sister skips and laughs. Then everyone takes photos together.
en.baihat: Happy New Year (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Happy New Year, lucky money, lucky money, lucky money, / Happy New Year, lucky money, I wish you well! / Watch the fireworks, lion dance, lion dance, lion dance, / Watch the fireworks, lion dance, skip and celebrate!

zh.flash: Mới: 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 烟花 yānhuā | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 村子 cūnzi, 市中心 shì zhōngxīn, 拍照 pāizhào, 狮子 shīzi, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 时候 shíhou | Nghe làm quen: 幸运 xìngyùn, 祝 zhù, 跳绳 tiàoshéng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và nối người với hoạt động ngày Tết (dạng YCT3 听力, 5 người, cùng tranh bài tiếng Anh): Nhan拿红包。/ 奶奶给礼物。/ Leo看烟花。/ Leo的妹妹跳绳。/ 爷爷拍照。 2) Chọn từ điền câu (烟花 / 新年快乐 / 幸运 / 红包; thẻ nhiễu: 月饼): 新年的时候，我们看___。/ 奶奶，___！/ 七是我的___数字。/ 奶奶给我一个___。 3) Viết thiệp chúc Tết trên slide rồi đọc to: 奶奶，祝你新年快乐！谢谢你的红包！ [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh Tết: Leo nói "During New Year, we watch the fireworks.", Xiaomei nói "新年的时候，我们看烟花。"; con nhận ra during đứng trước ↔ 的时候 đứng sau. Cặp lucky money ↔ 红包 (gọi theo màu phong bao). [Chuyển ngữ] [Larva: tin nhắn ngắn] Thiệp chúc Tết tiếng Anh trên slide: "Dear Grandma, I wish you a happy New Year! Thank you for the lucky money!" Con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho bà của Xiaomei: 奶奶，祝你新年快乐！谢谢你的红包！ [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "During New Year, my family visits Grandma and Grandpa. Grandma gives me lucky money in a red envelope, and I wish her a happy New Year. In the evening, we watch the lion dance and the fireworks. Grandpa takes lots of photos." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: 新年的时候，Leo去看奶奶和爷爷。奶奶给他红包，他说：“祝你新年快乐！”晚上他们看舞狮和烟花。 (Xīnnián de shíhou, Leo qù kàn nǎinai hé yéye. Nǎinai gěi tā hóngbāo, tā shuō: “Zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!” Wǎnshang tāmen kàn wǔshī hé yānhuā.)
zh.truyen: 新年 — 新年，Nhan和家人去爷爷奶奶的村子。Nhan说：“奶奶，祝你新年快乐！”奶奶给他一个红包和一个小礼物。Nhan说：“我真幸运！”放假的时候，他们去市中心看舞狮，看烟花。Nhan的妹妹又跳绳又笑。然后，大家一起拍照。(Xīnnián, Nhan hé jiārén qù yéye nǎinai de cūnzi. Nhan shuō: “Nǎinai, zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!” Nǎinai gěi tā yí gè hóngbāo hé yí gè xiǎo lǐwù. Nhan shuō: “Wǒ zhēn xìngyùn!” Fàngjià de shíhou, tāmen qù shì zhōngxīn kàn wǔshī, kàn yānhuā. Nhan de mèimei yòu tiàoshéng yòu xiào. Ránhòu, dàjiā yìqǐ pāizhào.)
zh.baihat: 新年快乐 (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 新年快乐，拿红包，拿红包，拿红包，/ 新年快乐，拿红包，祝你快乐！/ 看看烟花，看舞狮，看舞狮，看舞狮，/ 看看烟花，看舞狮，跳绳庆祝！(Xīnnián kuàilè, ná hóngbāo, ná hóngbāo, ná hóngbāo, / xīnnián kuàilè, ná hóngbāo, zhù nǐ kuàilè! / Kànkan yānhuā, kàn wǔshī, kàn wǔshī, kàn wǔshī, / kànkan yānhuā, kàn wǔshī, tiàoshéng qìngzhù!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 53. Unit 12 · Let's Celebrate – Kỳ nghỉ hè, săn kho báu, Kinh kịch; ôn không tranh · Luyện Movers Nói phần 4

web.label: Ngày 105. Unit 12 · Kỳ nghỉ hè ở Bắc Kinh: hồ bơi, kho báu, Kinh kịch

en.tu: Mới: swimsuit, treasure | Ôn: holiday, swimming pool, visit, Beijing | Ôn nhanh: practise, team, win
en.cum: my new swimsuit / look for the treasure / a treasure hunt / during the summer holiday / at the swimming pool
en.cau: During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. / I put my swimsuit in my suitcase. / Let's look for the treasure! / Is the treasure under the water? / Our team wins the treasure hunt! / Is the treasure inside the box? – No, there's nothing in it!
en.truyen: Holiday in Beijing — During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. In the evening they watch Beijing opera. The next day they go to the swimming pool. Xiaomei wears her new swimsuit. Grandpa says, "Let's look for the treasure! It's in the water." Xiaomei finds a small toy fish and laughs.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "treasure hunt game for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 京剧 jīngjù (= Beijing opera) | Ôn: 北京 Běijīng, 游泳池 yóuyǒngchí, 行李箱 xínglixiāng, 找 zhǎo, 盒子 hézi, 放假 fàngjià | Ôn nhanh: 练习 liànxí, 队 duì, 赢 yíng | Nghe làm quen: 泳衣 yǒngyī (= swimsuit), 宝藏 bǎozàng (= treasure)
zh.cum: 夏天放假的时候 xiàtiān fàngjià de shíhou / 我的新泳衣 wǒ de xīn yǒngyī / 找宝藏 zhǎo bǎozàng / 在游泳池 zài yóuyǒngchí / 看京剧 kàn jīngjù
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Beijing opera ↔ 京剧 [giống: 京 là chữ 京 trong 北京 = Beijing] / 夏天放假的时候，Xiaomei去北京看爷爷。(Xiàtiān fàngjià de shíhou, Xiaomei qù Běijīng kàn yéye.) / 我把泳衣放在行李箱里。(Wǒ bǎ yǒngyī fàng zài xínglixiāng li.) / 我们找宝藏吧！(Wǒmen zhǎo bǎozàng ba!) / 宝藏在水下面吗？(Bǎozàng zài shuǐ xiàmiàn ma?) / 我们队赢了找宝藏的游戏！(Wǒmen duì yíng le zhǎo bǎozàng de yóuxì!) / 宝藏在盒子里吗？——不在，盒子里什么也没有！(Bǎozàng zài hézi li ma? — Bú zài, hézi li shénme yě méiyǒu!) / 晚上我们一起看京剧。(Wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ kàn jīngjù.)
zh.truyen: 在北京放假 — 夏天放假的时候，Xiaomei去北京看爷爷。晚上，他们一起看京剧。第二天，他们去游泳池。Xiaomei穿上新泳衣。爷爷说：“我们找宝藏吧！宝藏在水里。”Xiaomei找到了一个小玩具鱼，她笑了。(Xiàtiān fàngjià de shíhou, Xiaomei qù Běijīng kàn yéye. Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ kàn jīngjù. Dì-èr tiān, tāmen qù yóuyǒngchí. Xiaomei chuān shang xīn yǒngyī. Yéye shuō: “Wǒmen zhǎo bǎozàng ba! Bǎozàng zài shuǐ li.” Xiaomei zhǎodào le yí gè xiǎo wánjù yú, tā xiào le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "找宝藏 游戏 儿童 中文"

web.label: Ngày 106. Unit 12 · Ôn không tranh

en.tu: Ôn: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern, lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip, swimsuit, treasure, circus, invite, inside, nothing | Ôn nhanh: straight, skate
en.cum: the Mid-Autumn Festival / lucky money / watch the fireworks / the lion dance / during New Year / look for the treasure
en.cau: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / What do you do at New Year? – We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival? / I'm very happy at New Year. / During the festival, we skip and laugh. / [Movers Nói phần 4 (mẫu; trên web: nghe câu hỏi, ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói, ~10 phút)] What's your favourite festival? / What do you do during the holiday? – I swim in my swimsuit. / Who do you invite to your birthday party? / Do you like the circus? / Is there any treasure inside the box? – No, there's nothing in it.
en.truyen: Which Festival? — "We eat mooncakes and carry lanterns. Which festival is it?" "The Mid-Autumn Festival!" "We get lucky money and watch the fireworks. Which festival is it?" "New Year!" "I wish you a happy New Year!" says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Vietnamese Tet holiday for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 烟花 yānhuā, 幸运 xìngyùn, 祝 zhù, 跳绳 tiàoshéng, 泳衣 yǒngyī, 宝藏 bǎozàng, 马戏 mǎxì, 请 qǐng, 放假 fàngjià | Ôn nhanh: 滑冰 huábīng | Nghe làm quen: 提灯笼 tí dēnglong (= carry lanterns)
zh.cum: 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié / 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 看烟花 kàn yānhuā / 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 新年的时候 xīnnián de shíhou / 找宝藏 zhǎo bǎozàng
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Which festival is it? ↔ 这是什么节日？[khác: Which đứng đầu câu, 什么 đứng ở chỗ của từ cần hỏi] / 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 新年你们做什么？——我们拿红包。(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme? — Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.) / 节日的时候，我们跳绳，一起笑。(Jiérì de shíhou, wǒmen tiàoshéng, yìqǐ xiào.) / [YCT口语 – trả lời về mình, cùng câu hỏi Movers Nói phần 4] 放假的时候你做什么？——我穿泳衣去游泳。(Fàngjià de shíhou nǐ zuò shénme? — Wǒ chuān yǒngyī qù yóuyǒng.) / 你请谁来你的生日会？(Nǐ qǐng shéi lái nǐ de shēngrì huì?) / 你喜欢看马戏吗？(Nǐ xǐhuan kàn mǎxì ma?) / 盒子里有宝藏吗？——没有，什么也没有。(Hézi li yǒu bǎozàng ma? — Méiyǒu, shénme yě méiyǒu.) / [Chuyển ngữ] [Xiaomei kể bằng tiếng Trung; con nói lại bằng tiếng Anh cho Leo] 夏天我去北京看爷爷。晚上我们看京剧。→ During the summer holiday, I visit my grandpa in Beijing. In the evening we watch Beijing opera.
zh.truyen: 这是什么节日？— “我们吃月饼，提灯笼。这是什么节日？”“中秋节！”“我们拿红包，看烟花。这是什么节日？”“新年！”Leo说：“祝你新年快乐！”(“Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, tí dēnglong. Zhè shì shénme jiérì?” “Zhōngqiū Jié!” “Wǒmen ná hóngbāo, kàn yānhuā. Zhè shì shénme jiérì?” “Xīnnián!” Leo shuō: “Zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "春节 拿红包 看烟花 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Mới: swimsuit, treasure | Ôn: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern, lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip, swimming pool, Beijing opera
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Good morning! Let's look for the treasure! 我们找一找吧！· Chuyển ý: Now, it's speaking time. 现在说一说。· Khen: You're a star! 你真棒！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: treasure, Beijing opera / 京剧 1) Trò chơi săn kho báu trên slide: nghe chỉ dẫn, kéo nhân vật tới kho báu (6 lệnh): The treasure is under the rock. / Open the box. The treasure is inside! / This box has got nothing in it. / It's next to the swimming pool. / It's between the lantern and the mooncake. / It's in front of the hotel. 2) Ôn không tranh – đọc gợi ý, nói tên lễ hội (dạng Movers Reading Part 1): We eat mooncakes and carry lanterns. (the Mid-Autumn Festival) / We get lucky money and watch fireworks. (New Year) / We have a cake and candles. (a birthday). 3) Nói câu với "during": During the summer holiday, I … / During New Year, we … 4) Movers Nói phần 4 – Câu hỏi về bản thân (mẫu; từng con với cô): What's your favourite festival? – The Mid-Autumn Festival. / What do you do during the summer holiday? – I go to the swimming pool in my new swimsuit. / Who do you invite to your birthday party? – I invite my friends. / Do you like going to the circus? – Yes, I do. / Tell me about your favourite festival. – We eat mooncakes and look at the moon. I've got a red lantern.
en.truyen: Holiday in Beijing — During the summer holiday, Xiaomei visits her grandpa in Beijing. In the evening they watch Beijing opera. The clothes are red and gold, and the music is loud. The next day they go to the swimming pool. Xiaomei wears her new swimsuit. Grandpa says, "Let's have a treasure hunt! The treasure is in the water." Xiaomei looks and looks. She finds a small toy fish and laughs. "I'm lucky!"
en.baihat: Treasure Hunt (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Look, look, look for treasure, / Under every rock! / Put on your swimsuit, jump in the pool, / Find the treasure box!

zh.flash: Mới: 京剧 jīngjù | Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 放假 fàngjià, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 幸运 xìngyùn, 祝 zhù, 礼物 lǐwù, 烟花 yānhuā, ……的时候 de shíhou, 跳绳 tiàoshéng, 游泳池 yóuyǒngchí | Nghe làm quen: 泳衣 yǒngyī, 宝藏 bǎozàng
zh.slide: 1) Trò chơi săn kho báu trên slide: nghe chỉ dẫn tiếng Trung, kéo nhân vật tới kho báu (cùng sơ đồ bài tiếng Anh): 宝藏在石头下面。/ 打开盒子，宝藏在里面！/ 这个盒子里什么也没有。/ 宝藏在游泳池旁边。/ 在灯笼和月饼中间。/ 在酒店前面。 2) Ôn không tranh – nghe gợi ý, nói tên lễ hội: 我们吃月饼，提灯笼 → 中秋节 / 我们拿红包，看烟花 → 新年 / 我们吃蛋糕，点蜡烛 → 生日. 3) Nói câu với ……的时候: 夏天放假的时候，我…… / 新年的时候，我们…… 4) Trả lời câu hỏi về mình (cùng câu hỏi Movers Nói phần 4): 你最喜欢什么节日？/ 放假的时候你做什么？— 我穿新泳衣去游泳池。/ 你请谁来你的生日会？— 我请我的朋友。/ 你喜欢看马戏吗？— 喜欢。 [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh Bắc Kinh: Leo nói "Beijing opera", Xiaomei nói "京剧"; con tìm chữ 京 trong 北京. Cặp Which festival is it? ↔ 这是什么节日？ (từ hỏi đầu câu ↔ cuối câu). [Chuyển ngữ] [Larva: 2–3 câu] Xiaomei kể bằng tiếng Trung: "夏天我去北京看爷爷。晚上我们看京剧。第二天我们去游泳。" Con nói lại bằng tiếng Anh cho Leo: During the summer holiday, I visit my grandpa in Beijing. In the evening we watch Beijing opera. The next day we go swimming. [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "During the summer holiday, I went on a treasure hunt at the beach with my friends. First we looked under a big rock, but there was nothing there. Then we found a box next to the hotel swimming pool. We opened it, and the treasure was inside! It was the best day of the holiday." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: 夏天放假的时候，Leo和朋友找宝藏。先看石头下面，什么也没有。然后他们打开游泳池旁边的盒子，宝藏在里面！ (Xiàtiān fàngjià de shíhou, Leo hé péngyou zhǎo bǎozàng. Xiān kàn shítou xiàmiàn, shénme yě méiyǒu. Ránhòu tāmen dǎkāi yóuyǒngchí pángbiān de hézi, bǎozàng zài lǐmiàn!)
zh.truyen: 在北京放假 — 夏天放假的时候，Xiaomei去北京看爷爷。晚上，他们一起看京剧。京剧的衣服是红色和金色的，音乐的声音很大。第二天，他们去游泳池。Xiaomei穿上新泳衣。爷爷说：“我们来找宝藏吧！宝藏在水里。”Xiaomei找了又找，找到了一个小玩具鱼。她笑了：“我真幸运！”(Xiàtiān fàngjià de shíhou, Xiaomei qù Běijīng kàn yéye. Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ kàn jīngjù. Jīngjù de yīfu shì hóngsè hé jīnsè de, yīnyuè de shēngyīn hěn dà. Dì-èr tiān, tāmen qù yóuyǒngchí. Xiaomei chuān shang xīn yǒngyī. Yéye shuō: “Wǒmen lái zhǎo bǎozàng ba! Bǎozàng zài shuǐ li.” Xiaomei zhǎo le yòu zhǎo, zhǎodào le yí gè xiǎo wánjù yú. Tā xiào le: “Wǒ zhēn xìngyùn!”)
zh.baihat: 找宝藏 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 找，找，找宝藏，/ 石头下面找！/ 穿上泳衣，跳进水里，/ 找到宝藏盒！(Zhǎo, zhǎo, zhǎo bǎozàng, / shítou xiàmiàn zhǎo! / Chuān shang yǒngyī, tiào jìn shuǐ li, / zhǎodào bǎozàng hé!)

en.tu: Ôn: festival, celebrate, lantern, mooncake, lucky, wish, gift, card | Ôn từ U9: come on, idea, shall, playground, laugh
en.cum: a class festival / make lanterns / write wish cards / lucky money game / celebrate together
en.cau: Shall we have a class festival? – Good idea! / We make red lanterns. / We write wish cards. / Come on, let's celebrate together! / Let's invite our mums and dads! / There's a circus show at our festival.
en.truyen: Our Class Festival — "Shall we have a festival in our class?" asks the teacher. "Good idea!" say the children. Anna and Bông make red lanterns. Leo brings mooncakes. Nhan and Xiaomei write wish cards: "I wish you a happy New Year!" In the playground, they play a lucky money game and watch a lion dance. Everyone laughs and celebrates together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how to make a paper lantern for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 灯笼 dēnglong, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 红包 hóngbāo, 舞狮 wǔshī, 卡片 kǎpiàn, 祝 zhù, 请 qǐng, 马戏 mǎxì | Ôn từ U9: 快来 kuài lái, ……，好吗？ hǎo ma, 操场 cāochǎng, 笑 xiào | Nghe làm quen: 祝福卡片 zhùfú kǎpiàn (= wish card)
zh.cum: 我们班的节日 wǒmen bān de jiérì / 做灯笼 zuò dēnglong / 写祝福卡片 xiě zhùfú kǎpiàn / 拿红包的游戏 ná hóngbāo de yóuxì / 在操场上看舞狮 zài cāochǎng shang kàn wǔshī / 一起庆祝 yìqǐ qìngzhù
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Shall we have a class festival? ↔ 我们班一起庆祝节日，好吗？[giống: lời rủ dạng câu hỏi; khác: Shall we đứng đầu câu, 好吗 đứng cuối câu] / 我们班一起庆祝节日，好吗？——好啊！(Wǒmen bān yìqǐ qìngzhù jiérì, hǎo ma? — Hǎo a!) / 我们做红灯笼。(Wǒmen zuò hóng dēnglong.) / 我们写祝福卡片。(Wǒmen xiě zhùfú kǎpiàn.) / 快来，我们一起庆祝吧！(Kuài lái, wǒmen yìqǐ qìngzhù ba!) / 我们请爸爸妈妈来吧！(Wǒmen qǐng bàba māma lái ba!) / 我们的节日有马戏！(Wǒmen de jiérì yǒu mǎxì!)
zh.truyen: 我们班的节日 — 老师说：“我们班一起庆祝节日，好吗？”小朋友们说：“好啊！”Anna和Bông做红灯笼。Leo拿来月饼。Nhan和Xiaomei写祝福卡片：“祝你新年快乐！”在操场上，大家玩拿红包的游戏，看舞狮。大家都笑了，一起庆祝！(Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen bān yìqǐ qìngzhù jiérì, hǎo ma?” Xiǎopéngyoumen shuō: “Hǎo a!” Anna hé Bông zuò hóng dēnglong. Leo ná lái yuèbǐng. Nhan hé Xiaomei xiě zhùfú kǎpiàn: “Zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!” Zài cāochǎng shang, dàjiā wán ná hóngbāo de yóuxì, kàn wǔshī. Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ qìngzhù!)

en.tu: Ôn: Mid-Autumn Festival, mooncakes, lion dance, New Year, lucky money, favourite festival, happy | Ôn nhanh: ice, team
en.cum: This is … / eat mooncakes / watch the lion dance / at New Year / get lucky money / my favourite festival
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Trung, nói câu tiếng Anh] This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance. / What do you do at New Year? / We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival? / I'm very happy at New Year.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter Xiaomei — A new friend from London visits Xiaomei's class during the Mid-Autumn Festival. He doesn't understand Chinese. The teacher says something in Chinese, and Xiaomei helps: "This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and watch the lion dance." The new friend smiles. "Thank you! Now I understand!"
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Mid-Autumn Festival story for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn: 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 舞狮 wǔshī, 新年 xīnnián, 红包 hóngbāo, 节日 jiérì, 开心 kāixīn | Ôn nhanh: 冰 bīng, 队 duì
zh.cum: 这是…… zhè shì… / 吃月饼 chī yuèbǐng / 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 新年 xīnnián / 拿红包 ná hóngbāo / 最喜欢的节日 zuì xǐhuan de jiérì
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. ↔ 这是中秋节。[giống: This is ↔ 这是; khác: không cần the] / [Phiên dịch nhí: nghe câu tiếng Anh, nói câu tiếng Trung] 这是中秋节。(Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié.) / 我们吃月饼，看舞狮。(Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.) / 新年你们做什么？(Xīnnián nǐmen zuò shénme?) / 我们拿红包。(Wǒmen ná hóngbāo.) / 你最喜欢什么节日？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì?) / 新年我很开心。(Xīnnián wǒ hěn kāixīn.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译Xiaomei — 中秋节的时候，一个伦敦的新朋友来Xiaomei的班。他不懂汉语。老师用汉语说：“这是中秋节。我们吃月饼，看舞狮。”Xiaomei用英语告诉他。新朋友笑了：“谢谢你！我懂了！”(Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, yí gè Lúndūn de xīn péngyou lái Xiaomei de bān. Tā bù dǒng Hànyǔ. Lǎoshī yòng Hànyǔ shuō: “Zhè shì Zhōngqiū Jié. Wǒmen chī yuèbǐng, kàn wǔshī.” Xiaomei yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu tā. Xīn péngyou xiào le: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ dǒng le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中秋节的故事 儿童 动画"

en.flash: Ôn: festival, holiday, celebrate, mid-autumn, mooncake, lantern, lucky, wish, gift, firework, during, skip, swimsuit, treasure | Ôn từ khóa trước: card, present, birthday, take a photo
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Let's make lanterns! 我们做灯笼吧！· Chuyển ý: Next, let's be little interpreters. 下面我们做小翻译。· Khen: Great work! 做得真好！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: wish, celebrate 1) Làm đèn lồng theo lệnh trên slide (thủ công, mỗi bước 1 câu): Draw a big circle. / Colour it red. / Cut it out. / Draw a star in the middle. / Write a wish on your lantern: I wish … 2) Đọc truyện, trả lời câu hỏi (dạng Movers Reading, 4 câu): Who makes lanterns? / What does Leo bring? / What do Nhan and Xiaomei write? / Where do they watch the lion dance? 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: bạn A nói câu tiếng Trung, bạn B nói tiếng Anh: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. / We get lucky money. / What's your favourite festival? 4) Viết thiệp mời ba mẹ dự lễ hội của lớp rồi đọc to: Dear Mum and Dad, We want to invite you to our class festival on Friday. There's a lantern show and a circus show. Come and celebrate with us! Love, …
en.truyen: Our Class Festival — "Shall we have a festival in our class?" asks the teacher. "Good idea!" say the children. Anna and Bông make red lanterns. Leo brings mooncakes for everyone. Nhan and Xiaomei write wish cards: "I wish you a happy New Year!" During the festival, the children play a lucky money game in the playground and watch a lion dance. Then they take a photo together. "This is the best festival!" says Anna. Everyone laughs and celebrates.
en.baihat: Let's Celebrate! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The lanterns at the festival go round and round, / Round and round, round and round. / The lion dance at New Year goes jump, jump, jump, / Jump, jump, jump! / The children with their lucky money say "Thank you!", / "Thank you! Thank you!"

zh.flash: Ôn: 节日 jiérì, 放假 fàngjià, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 中秋节 Zhōngqiū Jié, 月饼 yuèbǐng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 幸运 xìngyùn, 红包 hóngbāo, 祝 zhù, 礼物 lǐwù, 烟花 yānhuā, ……的时候 de shíhou, 跳绳 tiàoshéng, 泳衣 yǒngyī, 宝藏 bǎozàng | Ôn từ khóa trước: 卡片 kǎpiàn, 祝福卡片 zhùfú kǎpiàn, 生日 shēngrì, 拍照 pāizhào
zh.slide: 1) Làm đèn lồng theo lệnh tiếng Trung (thủ công, cùng các bước bài tiếng Anh): 画一个大圆圈。/ 把它涂成红色。/ 剪下来。/ 在中间画一个星星。/ 在灯笼上写：新年快乐！ 2) Nghe truyện, chọn đúng/sai (dạng YCT3, 4 câu): Anna做红灯笼。/ Leo拿来红包。/ 他们在教室里看舞狮。/ 大家都很开心。 3) [Chuyển ngữ] Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Anh, con nói câu tiếng Trung: This is the Mid-Autumn Festival. → 这是中秋节。/ We get lucky money. → 我们拿红包。/ What's your favourite festival? → 你最喜欢什么节日？ [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "On Friday our class celebrated a festival in the playground. Anna made a red lantern, and I brought mooncakes for everyone. Nhan and Xiaomei wrote wishes on their cards. Then we all watched the lion dance together, and everyone was very happy." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: 星期五我们班在操场上庆祝节日。Anna做了红灯笼，Leo给大家拿来了月饼。大家一起看舞狮，都很开心。 (Xīngqīwǔ wǒmen bān zài cāochǎng shang qìngzhù jiérì. Anna zuò le hóng dēnglong, Leo gěi dàjiā ná lái le yuèbǐng. Dàjiā yìqǐ kàn wǔshī, dōu hěn kāixīn.) 4) YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 – làm quen câu dài (5 câu; cô mở ghi âm từng câu, con nghe 1 lần rồi nói lại, cô ghi âm và chỉ ra từ con bỏ sót): 中秋节的时候，我们一起吃月饼，看月亮。(Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, wǒmen yìqǐ chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang.) / 新年的时候，奶奶给我一个红包。(Xīnnián de shíhou, nǎinai gěi wǒ yí gè hóngbāo.) / 我们班一起做红灯笼，写祝福卡片。(Wǒmen bān yìqǐ zuò hóng dēnglong, xiě zhùfú kǎpiàn.) / 节日的时候，我们在操场上看舞狮。(Jiérì de shíhou, wǒmen zài cāochǎng shang kàn wǔshī.) / Leo给大家拿来了月饼。(Leo gěi dàjiā ná lái le yuèbǐng.) 5) Viết thiệp mời ba mẹ rồi đọc to: 爸爸妈妈，星期五请来我们班的节日！有灯笼，还有马戏。和我们一起庆祝吧！ [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng đèn lồng con vừa làm: Leo nói "Shall we have a class festival?", Xiaomei nói "我们班一起庆祝节日，好吗？"; con nhận ra câu hỏi rủ Shall we…? đứng đầu câu ↔ 好吗 đứng cuối câu. Cặp This is ↔ 这是 (không cần the).
zh.truyen: 我们班的节日 — 老师说：“我们班一起庆祝节日，好吗？”小朋友们说：“好啊！”Anna和Bông做红灯笼。Leo给大家拿来月饼。Nhan和Xiaomei写祝福卡片：“祝你新年快乐！”节日的时候，大家在操场上玩拿红包的游戏，看舞狮。然后大家一起拍照。Anna说：“这是最好的节日！”大家都笑了，一起庆祝。(Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen bān yìqǐ qìngzhù jiérì, hǎo ma?” Xiǎopéngyoumen shuō: “Hǎo a!” Anna hé Bông zuò hóng dēnglong. Leo gěi dàjiā ná lái yuèbǐng. Nhan hé Xiaomei xiě zhùfú kǎpiàn: “Zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè!” Jiérì de shíhou, dàjiā zài cāochǎng shang wán ná hóngbāo de yóuxì, kàn wǔshī. Ránhòu dàjiā yìqǐ pāizhào. Anna shuō: “Zhè shì zuì hǎo de jiérì!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ qìngzhù.)
zh.baihat: 我们一起庆祝吧 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 节日里的灯笼转呀转，/ 转呀转，转呀转。/ 新年的舞狮跳，跳，跳，/ 跳，跳，跳！/ 拿着红包的小朋友说“谢谢！”/ “谢谢！谢谢！”(Jiérì li de dēnglong zhuàn ya zhuàn, / zhuàn ya zhuàn, zhuàn ya zhuàn. / Xīnnián de wǔshī tiào, tiào, tiào, / tiào, tiào, tiào! / Ná zhe hóngbāo de xiǎopéngyou shuō “xièxie!” / “Xièxie! Xièxie!”)

en.tu: Ôn: country, flag, language, could, look for, always, sometimes, shower, half, quarter, past, minute, how long, cry, grow, future, engineer, pilot, police officer, dream, sweater, put on, take off, backpack
en.cum: Where are you from? / half past seven / a quarter past five / for thirty minutes / want to be a pilot / put on my sweater / take off my shoes
en.cau: Where are you from? – I'm from Vietnam. / What time is it? – It's half past seven. / How long do you study every day? – I study for thirty minutes. / What do you want to be? – I want to be a pilot. / What's your favourite colour? – I like blue best. / Put on your sweater. It's cold. / [Movers Nói – luyện trước thi thử (trên web ≤30 phút: nghe câu mẫu, nói theo, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói)] [Phần 1] In picture A, the girl has got fair hair. In picture B, she has got black hair. / [Phần 2] They look for the treasure. There's nothing under the rock. / [Phần 3] I think the snail is different because it hasn't got legs. / [Phần 4] What do you do at break time? – I play in the playground.
en.truyen: Leo's Day — Leo is from Vietnam and he can speak three languages. He always gets up at half past six. He has a shower and puts on his blue sweater. He studies English for thirty minutes every day. In the future, he wants to be a pilot. "I can fly to every country in the world!" he says.

zh.tu: Ôn: 国家 guójiā, 语言 yǔyán, 半 bàn, 每 měi, 多久 duōjiǔ, 分钟 fēnzhōng, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 长大 zhǎngdà, 警察 jǐngchá, 开飞机 kāi fēijī, 毛衣 máoyī, 哭 kū, 穿 chuān, 鞋 xié, 最 zuì, 找 zhǎo, 头发 tóufa, 宝藏 bǎozàng
zh.cum: 你是哪国人 nǐ shì nǎ guó rén / 七点半 qī diǎn bàn / 每天 měitiān / 三十分钟 sānshí fēnzhōng / 想开飞机 xiǎng kāi fēijī / 穿上毛衣 chuān shang máoyī / 最喜欢 zuì xǐhuan
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] What time is it? – It's half past seven. ↔ 现在几点？——现在七点半。[giống: con số; khác: half past seven ↔ 七点半, giờ trước, 半 sau] / 你是哪国人？——我是越南人。(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? — Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.) / 现在几点？——现在七点半。(Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? — Xiànzài qī diǎn bàn.) / 你每天学习多久？——我学习三十分钟。(Nǐ měitiān xuéxí duōjiǔ? — Wǒ xuéxí sānshí fēnzhōng.) / 你长大以后想做什么？——我想开飞机。(Nǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme? — Wǒ xiǎng kāi fēijī.) / 你最喜欢什么颜色？——我最喜欢蓝色。(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè? — Wǒ zuì xǐhuan lánsè.) / 天冷了，穿上毛衣。(Tiān lěng le, chuān shang máoyī.) / [YCT口试（初级）– luyện nhanh, cùng tranh luyện Movers Nói] 看图说话：图A里女孩的头发是金色的，图B里是黑色的。(Tú A li nǚhái de tóufa shì jīnsè de, tú B li shì hēisè de.) / 他们找宝藏，石头下面什么也没有。(Tāmen zhǎo bǎozàng, shítou xiàmiàn shénme yě méiyǒu.)
zh.truyen: Leo的一天 — Leo是越南人，他会说三种语言。他每天六点半起床，然后洗澡，穿上蓝色的毛衣。他每天学习英语三十分钟。Leo长大以后想开飞机。他说：“我可以开飞机去世界上每个国家！”(Leo shì Yuènán rén, tā huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán. Tā měitiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, ránhòu xǐzǎo, chuān shang lánsè de máoyī. Tā měitiān xuéxí Yīngyǔ sānshí fēnzhōng. Leo zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng kāi fēijī. Tā shuō: “Wǒ kěyǐ kāi fēijī qù shìjiè shang měi gè guójiā!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的一天 现在几点 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 110. Cuối khóa · Ôn toàn khóa: Unit 5–8

en.tu: Ôn: kangaroo, panda, slow, fast, heavy, than, ice, skate, ice skating, roller skates, practise, team, win, volleyball, match, comic book, film star, sandwich, sweet, biscuit, excuse me, cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, autumn, winter
en.cum: bigger than / ice skating / win the match / a volleyball team / excuse me / a sore throat / have got a cough
en.cau: The elephant is bigger than the cat. / Can you play badminton? – Yes, I can. / Let's play table tennis together! / What would you like to drink? / Do you like apples or bananas? / How's the weather today? – It's sunny today. / I've got a sore throat.
en.truyen: The Big Match — It's summer and it's sunny. Anna's volleyball team has got a match. Anna is fast, but today she's got a cough and a sore throat. "Excuse me, can I sit down?" she asks. Her team practises hard and wins! After the match, they eat sandwiches and sweet biscuits.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports and food vocabulary review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 袋鼠 dàishǔ, 熊猫 xióngmāo, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 比 bǐ, 滑冰 huábīng, 排球 páiqiú, 队 duì, 赢 yíng, 比赛 bǐsài, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú, 电影明星 diànyǐng míngxīng, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饼干 bǐnggān, 甜 tián, 还是 háishi, 咳嗽 késou, 发烧 fāshāo, 疼 téng, 休息 xiūxi, 春天 chūntiān, 夏天 xiàtiān, 秋天 qiūtiān, 冬天 dōngtiān | Nghe làm quen: 努力 nǔlì (= hard: practise hard)
zh.cum: 比猫大 bǐ māo dà / 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú / 一起打乒乓球 yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú / 苹果还是香蕉 píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo / 嗓子疼 sǎngzi téng
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] The elephant is bigger than the cat. ↔ 大象比猫大。[khác: bigger than ↔ 比……大, 比 đứng trước vật so sánh, tính từ không đổi] / 大象比猫大。(Dàxiàng bǐ māo dà.) / 你会打羽毛球吗？——会。(Nǐ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú ma? — Huì.) / 我们一起打乒乓球吧！(Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú ba!) / 你想喝什么？(Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme?) / 你喜欢苹果还是香蕉？(Nǐ xǐhuan píngguǒ háishi xiāngjiāo?) / 今天天气怎么样？——今天是晴天。(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? — Jīntiān shì qíngtiān.) / 我嗓子疼。(Wǒ sǎngzi téng.) / [Chuyển ngữ] [Anna kể bằng tiếng Anh; con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho Xiaomei] I've got a sore throat. I can't play volleyball today. I sit down and rest. → 我嗓子疼。今天我不能打排球。我在旁边休息。
zh.truyen: 大比赛 — 夏天，今天是晴天。Anna的排球队有一个比赛。Anna跑得很快，可是今天她咳嗽，嗓子疼。她问：“请问，我可以坐下吗？”她的队努力练习，最后赢了！比赛以后，大家一起吃三明治和甜饼干。(Xiàtiān, jīntiān shì qíngtiān. Anna de páiqiú duì yǒu yí gè bǐsài. Anna pǎo de hěn kuài, kěshì jīntiān tā késou, sǎngzi téng. Tā wèn: “Qǐngwèn, wǒ kěyǐ zuòxià ma?” Tā de duì nǔlì liànxí, zuìhòu yíng le! Bǐsài yǐhòu, dàjiā yìqǐ chī sānmíngzhì hé tián bǐnggān.)

en.flash: Ôn U1–4: country, language, flag, half past, quarter, always, sometimes, engineer, pilot, future, police officer, sweater, put on, take off | Ôn U5–8: kangaroo, panda, fast, slow, than, team, win, volleyball, sandwich, sweet, excuse me, cough, sore throat, summer, winter
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Good morning! Today we have a mini test. 今天我们有一个小考试。· Nhắc: Read the question carefully. 请认真看题。· Khen: You did it! 你做到了！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp và nói quy trình thi thử 1) Thi thử mini dạng Movers Listening Part 1 (nghe và nối tên, 5 người): Leo – the boy in a blue sweater / Anna – the girl playing volleyball / Nhan – the boy with a cough / Bông – the girl eating a sandwich / Xiaomei – the girl looking at the kangaroo. 2) Dạng Movers Reading & Writing Part 1 (đọc định nghĩa, chọn từ, 5 câu): This person flies a plane. (pilot) / This animal is black and white. It lives in China. (panda) / You wear this when it's cold. (sweater) / This is the hot season. (summer) / You eat this. It's got bread and cheese in it. (sandwich). 3) Dạng Movers Speaking Part 1 (nhìn 2 tranh, nói 4 điểm khác nhau): In picture A, it's half past seven. In picture B, it's a quarter past eight. 4) Thi thử Movers Nói trọn 4 phần (5–7 phút/con, cô làm giám khảo, thi từng con, ghi âm; cô chấm theo từ vựng – ngữ pháp, phát âm, tương tác; trong lúc chờ lượt, các bạn làm bài 1–3 trên slide). Nhóm A (nửa lớp), bộ tranh 1. Phần 1 – Tìm điểm khác nhau (tranh nhà ăn). Cô: In picture A, the girl has got fair hair. In picture B, she has got black hair. Tell me the differences. – Con: In picture A, there are three apples on the plate. In picture B, there's nothing on the plate. / In picture A, the boy is drinking water. In picture B, he is eating rice with tomato sauce. / In picture A, the clock says half past twelve. In picture B, it says one o'clock. / In picture A, the window is a circle. In picture B, it's a square. Phần 2 – Kể truyện 4 tranh "The Treasure Hunt". Cô: (Tranh 1) Anna and Leo are at the beach. They've got a map. They want to find the treasure. – Con: (Tranh 2) They look for the treasure under a rock. There's a snail, but there's nothing under the rock. (Tranh 3) The wind is strong and Anna's hat falls on the ground. (Tranh 4) The hat is next to a box. The treasure is inside the box! They are very happy. Phần 3 – Chọn tranh khác loại. Cô (ví dụ): shark / whale / penguin / tractor → The tractor is different. It isn't an animal. – Con: supermarket / market / shopping centre / waterfall → I think the waterfall is different because you can't buy things there. / parrot / penguin / kangaroo / snail → I think the snail is different because it hasn't got legs. / laptop / e-book / email / ice skates → I think the ice skates are different because you can't use them on the internet. Phần 4 – Câu hỏi về bản thân: What's your name? / How old are you? / What do you do at break time? – I play in the playground. / Who do you invite to your birthday party? – My friends. / What do you put in your suitcase for a holiday? – My swimsuit and my toothpaste. / Tell me about your school. – My school has a big library. The canteen is next to the office.
en.truyen: Leo and Anna's Year — Leo is from Vietnam and he can speak three languages. He always gets up at half past six and studies English for thirty minutes. In the future he wants to be a pilot. His friend Anna loves sport. She is faster than Leo! In the summer her volleyball team has got a big match. Anna has got a cough, but her team practises and wins. "Excuse me, can we have some sandwiches?" says Leo. They eat and laugh together.
en.baihat: This Is Our Year (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Hello, friends from every country, / Half past seven, wake up, see! / Pilots, pandas, sports and food, / Summer, winter, all is good! / Hello, friends, let's sing together, / We are friends for ever and ever!

zh.slide: 1) Thi thử mini dạng YCT3 听力 Phần 1 (nghe câu, phán đoán đúng/sai với tranh nối tên, 5 câu, cùng tranh bài tiếng Anh): Leo穿蓝色的毛衣。/ Anna在打排球。/ Nhan咳嗽了。/ Bông在吃三明治。/ Xiaomei在看袋鼠。 2) Dạng YCT3 阅读 (đọc câu giải nghĩa, chọn từ, 5 câu, cùng nội dung bài tiếng Anh): 他开飞机。(飞行员) / 这个动物是黑白的，住在中国。(熊猫) / 天冷的时候穿。(毛衣) / 很热的季节。(夏天) / 你可以吃，里面有面包和奶酪。(三明治) 3) Dạng YCT3 口语 (nhìn 2 tranh, nói điểm khác nhau về giờ): 图A里现在七点半，图B里现在八点十五分。 4) Thi thử YCT口试（初级）trọn 3 phần, 25 câu (thi từng con với cô, ~10 phút thi + 7 phút chuẩn bị xem tranh; ghi âm toàn bộ, chấm thang 100, đạt từ 60; trong lúc chờ lượt, các bạn làm bài 1–3 trên slide). Nhóm B, bộ đề 1. 第一部分 听后重复 (15 câu, nghe 1 lần, nói lại): 我叫Anna。(Wǒ jiào Anna.) / 我今年八岁。(Wǒ jīnnián bā suì.) / 这是我的书。(Zhè shì wǒ de shū.) / 我喜欢吃苹果。(Wǒ xǐhuan chī píngguǒ.) / 今天星期六。(Jīntiān xīngqīliù.) / 我有一个妹妹。(Wǒ yǒu yí gè mèimei.) / 猫在桌子下面。(Māo zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn.) / 我们去学校吧。(Wǒmen qù xuéxiào ba.) / 爸爸在家看书。(Bàba zài jiā kàn shū.) / 我会说汉语。(Wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ.) / 现在八点半。(Xiànzài bā diǎn bàn.) / 这个苹果很大。(Zhège píngguǒ hěn dà.) / 我想喝水。(Wǒ xiǎng hē shuǐ.) / 图书馆在左边。(Túshūguǎn zài zuǒbiān.) / 我们一起去超市吧。(Wǒmen yìqǐ qù chāoshì ba.) 第二部分 听后回答 (5 câu, trả lời ngắn): 你叫什么名字？(Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?) — 我叫Leo。/ 你几岁？(Nǐ jǐ suì?) — 我八岁。/ 你家有几口人？(Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?) — 我家有四口人。/ 你喜欢什么动物？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme dòngwù?) — 我喜欢熊猫。/ 你怎么去学校？(Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào?) — 我坐公共汽车去学校。(Wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù xuéxiào.) 第三部分 看图说话 (5 tranh, mỗi tranh 2–3 câu): Tranh 1 (Leo đá bóng ở sân trường): Leo在操场上踢足球。他很高兴。(Leo zài cāochǎng shang tī zúqiú. Tā hěn gāoxìng.) / Tranh 2 (Xiaomei ăn bánh trung thu): Xiaomei在吃月饼。月饼很甜。(Xiaomei zài chī yuèbǐng. Yuèbǐng hěn tián.) / Tranh 3 (Bông và mẹ ở siêu thị): Bông和妈妈在超市买水果。苹果很便宜。(Bông hé māma zài chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ. Píngguǒ hěn piányi.) / Tranh 4 (Nhan ở bể bơi): Nhan在游泳。今天很热。(Nhan zài yóuyǒng. Jīntiān hěn rè.) / Tranh 5 (Anna đọc sách ở thư viện): Anna在图书馆看书。她很喜欢看书。(Anna zài túshūguǎn kàn shū. Tā hěn xǐhuan kàn shū.) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bộ tranh ôn U1–8: Leo nói "The elephant is bigger than the cat.", Xiaomei nói "大象比猫大。"; con nhận ra bigger than ↔ 比……大 (tính từ không đổi). Cặp half past seven ↔ 七点半. [Chuyển ngữ] [Larva: 2–3 câu] Cô đưa phiếu thông tin tiếng Anh về Leo ("Leo is from Vietnam. He gets up at half past six. He wants to be a pilot.") Con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung cho Xiaomei: Leo是越南人。他六点半起床。Leo长大以后想开飞机。 [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo đọc phiếu thông tin: "My friend Anna is from London, but now she lives in Vietnam. She gets up at half past seven and goes to school by bus. Her favourite season is summer because she can play volleyball on the beach. When she grows up, she wants to be a pilot." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 2–3 ý chính). Mẫu: Anna住在越南。她七点半起床，坐公共汽车去学校。她最喜欢夏天，长大以后想开飞机。 (Anna zhù zài Yuènán. Tā qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù xuéxiào. Tā zuì xǐhuan xiàtiān, zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng kāi fēijī.)
zh.truyen: Leo和Anna的一年 — Leo是越南人，他会说三种语言。他每天六点半起床，每天学习英语三十分钟。他长大以后想开飞机。他的朋友Anna喜欢运动，她跑得比Leo快！夏天，Anna的排球队有一个大比赛。Anna咳嗽了，可是她的队练习了，最后赢了！Leo说：“请问，我们可以吃三明治吗？”大家一起吃，一起笑。(Leo shì Yuènán rén, tā huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán. Tā měitiān liù diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, měitiān xuéxí Yīngyǔ sānshí fēnzhōng. Tā zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng kāi fēijī. Tā de péngyou Anna xǐhuan yùndòng, tā pǎo de bǐ Leo kuài! Xiàtiān, Anna de páiqiú duì yǒu yí gè dà bǐsài. Anna késou le, kěshì tā de duì liànxí le, zuìhòu yíng le! Leo shuō: “Qǐngwèn, wǒmen kěyǐ chī sānmíngzhì ma?” Dàjiā yìqǐ chī, yìqǐ xiào.)
zh.baihat: 我们的一年 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, cùng bài tiếng Anh) — 各国朋友你们好，/ 七点半了，快起床！/ 飞行员、熊猫、运动，/ 夏天、冬天，都很好！/ 你好，朋友，一起唱歌，/ 我们一直是好朋友！(Gè guó péngyou nǐmen hǎo, / qī diǎn bàn le, kuài qǐchuáng! / Fēixíngyuán, xióngmāo, yùndòng, / xiàtiān, dōngtiān, dōu hěn hǎo! / Nǐ hǎo, péngyou, yìqǐ chànggē, / wǒmen yìzhí shì hǎo péngyou!)

en.truyen: Bông's Town Guide — Bông makes a poster for her project. "This is my town. My school has a big library and a playground. The supermarket is next to the bus stop, and the fruit at the market is cheap. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, children carry lanterns in the street. Come and visit my town!" zh.tu: Ôn: 学校 xuéxiào, 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 操场 cāochǎng, 超市 chāoshì, 车站 chēzhàn, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 市场 shìchǎng, 便宜 piányi, 节日 jiérì, 灯笼 dēnglong, 旅行 lǚxíng, 参观 cānguān, 欢迎 huānyíng, 海报 hǎibào, 提灯笼 tí dēnglong
zh.cum: 这是我住的地方 zhè shì wǒ zhù de dìfang / 在……旁边 zài…pángbiān / ……的时候 …de shíhou / 欢迎你来参观 huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] The supermarket is next to the bus stop. ↔ 超市在车站旁边。[giống: cái gì – ở – đâu] / [Hồ sơ BRIDGE: con nói bài giới thiệu bằng tiếng Trung, rồi chuyển ngữ sang tiếng Anh] 这是我住的地方。(Zhè shì wǒ zhù de dìfang.) / 我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个操场。(Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yí gè dà túshūguǎn hé yí gè cāochǎng.) / 超市在车站旁边。(Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān.) / 市场的水果很便宜。(Shìchǎng de shuǐguǒ hěn piányi.) / 中秋节的时候，小朋友们提灯笼。(Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, xiǎopéngyoumen tí dēnglong.) / 欢迎你来参观！(Huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān!) / [Chuyển ngữ] [Bông giới thiệu bằng tiếng Anh; con nói lại ý chính bằng tiếng Trung cho khách] This is my town. The fruit at the market is cheap. Come and visit! → 这是我住的地方。市场的水果很便宜。欢迎你来参观！
zh.truyen: Bông的介绍 — Bông做了一张海报，介绍她住的地方：“这是我住的地方。我的学校有一个大图书馆和一个操场。超市在车站旁边，市场的水果很便宜。中秋节的时候，小朋友们在街上提灯笼。欢迎你来参观！”同学们说：“好啊！我们去看看！”(Bông zuò le yì zhāng hǎibào, jièshào tā zhù de dìfang: “Zhè shì wǒ zhù de dìfang. Wǒ de xuéxiào yǒu yí gè dà túshūguǎn hé yí gè cāochǎng. Chāoshì zài chēzhàn pángbiān, shìchǎng de shuǐguǒ hěn piányi. Zhōngqiū Jié de shíhou, xiǎopéngyoumen zài jiē shang tí dēnglong. Huānyíng nǐ lái cānguān!” Tóngxuémen shuō: “Hǎo a! Wǒmen qù kànkan!”)

en.flash: Ôn U9–12: gate, office, late, turn, left, right, have (got) to, come on, supermarket, shopping, cheap, expensive, money, how much, bus stop, ticket, travel, visit, hotel, suitcase, London, festival, holiday, lucky, wish, lantern, mooncake
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: Hello, everyone! Show us your poster. 给我们看看你的画。· Chuyển ý: Now, the next group, please. 下一组。· Khen: Wonderful! 太好了！· Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung: project, poster 1) Dạng Movers Listening (nghe và vẽ đường trên bản đồ thị trấn, 4 lệnh): Start at the school gate. / Turn left at the office. / The supermarket is next to the bus stop. / Go to the hotel and stop. 2) Trình bày dự án "My Town and Me": mỗi con giới thiệu poster bằng 4–5 câu theo khung: This is my town. / My school has … / The supermarket is next to … / During …, we … / Come and visit! 3) Hồ sơ BRIDGE – nhiệm vụ chuyển ngữ ghi âm: nghe bạn nói câu tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh: 图书馆在左边。→ The library is on the left. / 这个帽子太贵了。→ This hat is too expensive. / 我坐飞机去北京。→ I go to Beijing by plane. 4) Thi thử Movers Nói trọn 4 phần (5–7 phút/con, cô làm giám khảo, thi từng con, ghi âm; cô chấm theo từ vựng – ngữ pháp, phát âm, tương tác; trong lúc chờ lượt, các bạn làm bài 1–3 trên slide). Nhóm B (nửa lớp còn lại), bộ tranh 2. Phần 1 – Tìm điểm khác nhau (tranh trung tâm thành phố). Cô: In picture A, the man in the café has got fair hair. In picture B, he has got black hair. Tell me the differences. – Con: In picture A, there are two cars in the car park. In picture B, there's one car. / In picture A, the sports centre is next to the supermarket. In picture B, it's next to the café. / In picture A, there's a ticket machine at the bus station. In picture B, there's nothing there. / In picture A, the girl is sending a message. In picture B, she is reading an e-book. Phần 2 – Kể truyện 4 tranh "The Naughty Parrot". Cô: (Tranh 1) Xiaomei is at the zoo with Grandpa. They want to feed the parrots. – Con: (Tranh 2) A naughty parrot takes Grandpa's hat and flies away. (Tranh 3) The parrot sits on a rock next to the waterfall. Grandpa thinks it's funny. (Tranh 4) Xiaomei gives the parrot some fruit and it gives the hat back. Everyone laughs. Phần 3 – Chọn tranh khác loại: lantern / mooncake / moon / ticket → I think the ticket is different because it isn't for the Mid-Autumn Festival. / whale / shark / penguin / parrot → I think the parrot is different because it lives in the jungle. / hotel / café / supermarket / snail → I think the snail is different because it isn't a building. Phần 4 – Câu hỏi về bản thân: What's your favourite festival? / What do you do during the Mid-Autumn Festival? / How do you get to school? / Do you like the circus? / What do you do better: drawing or singing? – I sing better than I draw. / Tell me about your dream holiday. – I want to visit London. I'm going to stay at a hotel.
en.truyen: Bông's Town Guide — For the end-of-year project, Bông makes a poster about her town. "This is my town. My school has a big library and a playground. Turn left at the gate and you can see the supermarket. It's next to the bus stop. The fruit at the market is cheap, but the toys in the shopping centre are expensive. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, children carry lanterns and eat mooncakes. At New Year, we get lucky money. Come and visit my town!" Her friends say, "Good idea! Let's visit!"
en.baihat: Come and Visit My Town (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Come and visit my town, my town, my town, / Come and visit my town, it's lots of fun! / Turn left at the school gate, the school gate, the school gate, / Turn left at the school gate, then come on, run!
